title: Phone queue UI shows success after failed request
problem: Crisis Cleanup issue #1164 reports that a phone outbound update request failed with a CORS/network error while the UI still showed a green success banner saying the phone number was removed from the queue.
humanitarian_relevance: Incorrect success feedback in disaster-response phone workflows can mislead operators, but the issue is old and may have depended on a transient outage.

evidence.claim: Issue report provides expected/current behavior and the failing endpoint path.
On 2026-09-08, read-only GitHub issue metadata reported OPEN, no assignees, 0 comments, and updatedAt 2024-10-02T16:16:54Z. This does not establish maintainer availability or reproducibility.

At commit 64f72babb32346cca0d32c97d6f6dfd8d9dc56c9, removeNumberFromQueue already awaits completeCallsForPhoneNumber before showing the success toast. This is contrary evidence to a missing-await explanation, not proof the reported bug is fixed.
The model action awaits the POST to update_phone_number_completion. Actual ORM plugin and UI behavior have not been executed.
The shared Axios response-error interceptor rethrows errors after optional warning feedback. This source inspection is not an end-to-end reproduction.

The existing PhoneOutbound model test file was inspected; it contains neighboring API action tests but no completeCallsForPhoneNumber case. This bounded inspection does not establish absence of coverage elsewhere.
